# What does this role actually cost — hired, or contracted?

> Free calculator comparing the fully-loaded cost of a W-2 employee against a 1099 contractor for the same role — FICA, capped FUTA/SUTA, workers' comp, PTO, benefits, payroll admin, and one-time onboarding, plus the contractor rate at which the two cost the same. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
